description: This file defines a React hook 'useTeamFeatureOptIn' for managing feature opt-in at the team level, including functions for handling feature states, warnings, and API interactions.

methods.name: useMutationCallbacks
methods.description: Creates callback functions for success and error handling during feature state mutations, showing toast notifications.

methods.name: normalizeTeamFeatures
methods.description: Transforms raw feature data into normalized feature objects with slug, globalEnabled, and currentState.

methods.name: buildBlockingStateMap
methods.description: Builds a map of feature IDs to their organizational blocking states.

methods.name: createTeamBlockedWarningFn
methods.description: Returns a function that provides a warning message if a feature is org-disabled.

methods.name: createTeamIsBlockedByHigherLevelFn
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if a feature is blocked by higher organizational level.
